entities.name: Dual-registration mode
entities.description: Mode where UE maintains independent contexts for 5GMM and EMM with independent equivalent PLMN lists. UE can register to N1 mode only, S1 mode only, or both.

entities.name: S1 mode
entities.description: EMM registration mode for EPS connectivity.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered to the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered to the network.

entities.name: EPS attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach to EPS network, with or without PDN connection establishment.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to register to 5G network in N1 mode.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDU sessions in 5GS, can transfer existing PDN connections with request type 'existing PDU session'.

entities.name: PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDN connections in EPS, can transfer PDU sessions with request type 'handover'.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
entities.description: Message used in PDN connectivity procedure with request type parameter.

entities.name: Request type handover
entities.description: Condition where request type is set to 'handover' for transferring PDU sessions from N1 to S1 mode.

entities.name: Request type existing PDU session
entities.description: Condition where request type is set to 'existing PDU session' for transferring PDN connections from S1 to N1 mode.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support
entities.description: MME capability to support EMM-REGISTERED state without active PDN connections.

relations.description: Dual-registration mode can involve registration to N1 mode.
Dual-registration mode can involve registration to S1 mode.
EPS attach procedure establishes registration in S1 mode.
Initial registration procedure establishes registration in N1 mode.
PDN connectivity procedure uses PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message uses request type 'handover' for PDU session transfer.
PDU session establishment procedure uses request type 'existing PDU session' for PDN connection transfer.
If MME supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, UE stays in EMM-REGISTERED after transferring all PDN connections.
If MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED after transferring all PDN connections.
